$comment: The one list of KnowAll AI slide decks. Drives the presentations index cards (npm run decks:build), the QA harness (scripts/lib/deck-harness.mjs) and the site-index test. Paths are relative to /presentations/. A deck that is withdrawn moves to 'retired' and keeps a redirect page so shared links don't 404.

decks.title: Company Overview
decks.description: The full corporate overview — who we are, how we deliver from workshop to project, case studies, our products and agents, Presence, Reverie memory and the Purple Team.

decks.title: AI Discovery Workshop
decks.description: A focused one-day workshop to uncover where automation and AI can transform your organisation — pre-work surveys, on-site workshop, 1-to-1 interviews and a prioritised report.

decks.title: Continuous Improvement
decks.description: The Continuous Improvement Service Plan — proactive, flexible ongoing support via pre-purchased time-and-material blocks that keeps your solutions improving, month after month.

decks.title: The Purple Team
decks.description: Continuous AI security — Pennie attacks, Ollie defends and fixes, Poppie runs the loop. From new advisory to merged fix in your GitHub or Azure DevOps, with a portal that shows your score.

decks.title: T-Minus-15 Workshops
decks.description: Seven methodology workshops that take your team from Assemble to Operate, one chapter of the T-Minus-15 book at a time, with optional break-out labs, plus hands-on technology sessions on Azure DevOps, data, Power Platform, CI/CD and agentic coding, and a two-hour leadership briefing on running many teams.

decks.title: W-T1 Azure DevOps
decks.description: A hands-on, half-day technology workshop on running delivery in Azure DevOps: process templates, backlogs and boards, queries and dashboards, Test Plans, Repos and pull requests, and automation, with a step-by-step lab.

decks.title: W-T2 Data Storage
decks.description: Dataverse vs SharePoint vs Azure SQL, hands on: security models, scale and delegation, relationships, integration and licensing, and how to choose the right store for each solution, with a step-by-step lab.

decks.title: W-T3 Power Platform
decks.description: Canvas, model-driven and Code Apps, Power Automate, connectors and data loss prevention, and solution-based ALM: a hands-on half day for makers and developers, with a step-by-step lab.

decks.title: W-T4 CI/CD
decks.description: YAML pipelines in Azure DevOps, from build and test to environments, approvals, secrets, Bicep infrastructure-as-code and Power Platform solution deployment, with a step-by-step lab.

decks.title: W-T5 Agentic Coding
decks.description: Agentic coding with Claude Code: the agent loop, CLAUDE.md, skills and subagents, specs from acceptance criteria, MCP, hooks, CI and the guardrails that keep agent work trustworthy, with a step-by-step lab.

retired.note: The Agentic Delivery Workshop now lives in the Company Overview.
Agentic AI Solutions was folded into the Company Overview.
